semiconductor_relevance: High — ST Corporation specializes in semiconductor equipment and environmental safety products, particularly in RTP equipment services.
summary: ST Corporation provides semiconductor equipment services with a focus on Rapid Thermal Processing (RTP) equipment. They are also developing environmental safety products, such as a Gas Leak Monitoring System, aimed at enhancing safety in the semiconductor and industrial sectors.

regional_presence.Korea: ST Corporation is delivering and installing its Gas Leak Monitoring System to a large semiconductor company in Korea.
